record.original_question: If N is a Connes embeddable non-Gamma II_1 factor, must there exist an embedding π: N → M_U into a tracial matrix ultraproduct M_U = ∏_{n→U} M_n(C) such that the relative commutant N' ∩ M_U is exactly C?

evidence.quote: Problem 2. For every Connes embeddable non Gamma II1 factor N does there exist an embedding π : N ,→ MU such that N′ ∩ MU = C?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{U}$ be a free ultrafilter on $\mathbb{N}$, and let
$$M^{\mathcal{U}} \;=\; \prod_{n\to\mathcal{U}} M_n(\mathbb{C})$$
denote the tracial matrix ultraproduct, namely the quotient of $\ell^\infty(\mathbb{N},(M_n(\mathbb{C}),\mathrm{tr}_n))$ by the ideal of sequences $(x_n)$ with $\lim_{n\to\mathcal{U}}\mathrm{tr}_n(x_n^*x_n)=0$, equipped with the limit trace $\tau((x_n))=\lim_{n\to\mathcal{U}}\mathrm{tr}_n(x_n)$. The algebra $M^{\mathcal{U}}$ is a $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor.

A separable $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor $N$ with trace $\tau_N$ is called Connes embeddable if there exists a trace-preserving $*$-embedding of $N$ into $M^{\mathcal{U}}$ for some (equivalently, every) free ultrafilter $\mathcal{U}$ on $\mathbb{N}$. The factor $N$ is said to have property Gamma if for every finite subset $F\subset N$ and every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists a unitary $u\in N$ with $\tau_N(u)=0$ and $\|[u,x]\|_2<\varepsilon$ for all $x\in F$; otherwise $N$ is called non-Gamma.

For an embedding $\pi:N\hookrightarrow M^{\mathcal{U}}$, the relative commutant is
$$\pi(N)' \cap M^{\mathcal{U}} \;=\; \{\,y\in M^{\mathcal{U}} : y\pi(x)=\pi(x)y \text{ for all } x\in N\,\}.$$

Question: For every separable, Connes embeddable, non-Gamma $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor $N$, does there exist a free ultrafilter $\mathcal{U}$ on $\mathbb{N}$ and a trace-preserving embedding $\pi:N\hookrightarrow M^{\mathcal{U}}$ such that
$$\pi(N)' \cap M^{\mathcal{U}} \;=\; \mathbb{C}\cdot 1\,?$$
artifact.status_search_result: The question (the "ergodic Connes embedding problem" for non-Gamma II_1 factors) is listed as an open problem in a recent compilation of 50 open problems on ultraproduct II_1 factors. Although MIP*=RE refuted the original Connes embedding problem and recent work has produced non-Gamma non-Connes-embeddable factors, no published resolution of this specific factoriality-of-relative-commutant question for Connes embeddable non-Gamma factors was found. Status: open.

status_evidence.title: Factorial relative commutants and the generalized Jung property for II_1 factors
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses embeddings of non-Gamma factors into matrix ultraproducts with trivial relative commutant (Jung-type property), still under investigation.
status_evidence.claim: The problem of finding embeddings with trivial relative commutant for non-Gamma Connes-embeddable factors is an active open area.

status_evidence.title: The Connes Embedding Problem: A guided tour
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of CEP after MIP*=RE; ergodic / factorial commutant variants of CEP listed as open.
status_evidence.claim: Variants concerning trivial relative commutant in matrix ultraproducts remain open after MIP*=RE.
